description: Karnataka CM DK Shivakumar announces plans to take AI education to rural students, establish an AI University, and deepen industry partnerships to strengthen the state's technology ecosystem.
body_lead: Karnataka looks to deepen AI ecosystem with industry partnership, focus on youth and rural education Bengaluru, July 24 Karnataka Chief Minister DK Shivakumar on Friday said the government aims to take artificial intelligence education to rural students and build long-term industry partnerships to strengthen the state's AI ecosystem, while industry leaders backed the state's vision to position Bengaluru at the forefront of AI innovation.
